note: One line per card in questions/queue.jsonl. The planner owns the queue: add, rescore and kill cards freely, but never edit a card's sealed prediction (seal a new card instead).

fields.question: one sentence
fields.why: what it would change if answered
fields.engine: A benchmark | B code_learning | C discovery | D archaeology | E wet_loop | other
fields.parents: list of card ids this came from
fields.cheapest_test: the cheapest test that would answer it
fields.prediction: what you expect, stated before the test, with probabilities where possible
fields.kill_criterion: result that would make you drop this line
fields.evidence_tier: 1-4, the tier the answer would have
fields.value: 1-5, how much a clear answer matters
fields.p_informative: 0-1, chance the test gives a clear answer
fields.seal_name: name in sealed/SEALS.json if the prediction is sealed
